title: Desk bridge v0: perm
description: Permissions: request, query and revoke grants, and the prompter's side of a request. Asking and looking at one's own grants need no scope; the person decides. Seeing other callers' grants and answering prompts need perm:manage.

PermRequestRequest.description: Ask the person for a permission. Resolves when they answer.

reason.description: Why the caller asks, shown to the person in the prompt. Optional; a prompt without one says that none was given.

GrantDuration.description: How long a grant lasts. once: the next call it allows, then it expires. session: until Desk quits. always: kept on disk across restarts. Every grant lasts until revoked at the latest. perm.request defaults to session.

PermRequestResult.description: Result of perm.request. A refusal is a result, not an error. A request that a lasting grant (session or always) already covers is granted at once with that grant, unless the caller is an agent and the grant lies outside its allowlist.

RefusalReason.description: Why perm.request was refused without asking the person. refused-earlier: the person refused this caller this permission and scope earlier in the session; it holds until the caller is granted a permission that covers it. outside-allowlist: the caller is an agent (agent:<id>) and no permission in agents.<id>.allow of init.yaml covers the request; an agent is never granted anything outside a non-empty allowlist (ADR 0072). Absent from a result means the person (or the core's own prompter) refused this request.

PermQueryParams.description: Parameters of perm.query. With permission, only grants that cover it are returned.

PermRevokeRequest.description: Give a grant back. The person can also revoke any grant at any time.

PermRevokeParams.description: Parameters of perm.revoke. Without scope only the caller's own grants; with perm:manage any caller's.

Grant.description: A permission the person granted to the caller.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; absent means for as long as the duration allows.

PermListRequest.description: List every caller's grants, for the person's permissions view.

PermListParams.description: Parameters of perm.list. With caller, only that caller's grants are returned.

PermListResult.description: Result of perm.list, oldest grant first.

CallerGrant.description: A grant together with the caller that holds it.

PermAnswerRequest.description: The prompter answers a perm.prompt with the person's decision.

PermAnswerParams.description: Parameters of perm.answer. duration is what the person chose; absent keeps the one asked for.

parent.description: true grants the prompt's parent offer instead of the permission asked. Ignored when granted is false; invalid_params on a prompt that offers no parent.

PermPromptEvent.description: A caller asked for a permission and the person has to decide. Sent to callers that hold perm:manage. An agent's caller is agent:<id>; it asks only within its allowlist.

PermPromptData.description: Payload of perm.prompt: who asks, for what, why and for how long.

reason.description: The caller's reason, to show as it is. Absent when the caller gave none.

parent.description: The parent folder the person may grant instead: the same permission over the folder that holds the one asked for, offered when this caller asks for a third folder under it in the session. Never a root, the home folder or a folder holding it, nor a scope the person refused this caller earlier, nor, for an agent, a scope outside its allowlist.

PermChangedEvent.description: One of the caller's grants changed.
